connector.none: no captured Outlook connector; the Claude side serves the same Graph responses through its HTTP mock

reads.note: Outlook v1 message getAll with filter isRead eq false: GET /v1.0/me/messages?$filter=isRead eq false&$top=<limit>; n8n emits value[]

urlscan.io v1 node scan get: GET https://urlscan.io/api/v1/result/{scanId} (scanId is the scan reply's uuid, renamed by the node). Runs only when No error? is false (the scan reply has no error), after Wait 1 Minute
HTTP Request with the virusTotalApi credential (x-apikey): GET /api/v3/analyses/{data.id}?resource=<a docs URL the template leaves in>. The Slack text takes data.id.split("-")[1] as the URL id

branches: Get all unread messages returns no items, so nothing downstream runs
expect.offline: Find indicators of compromise is a Python Code node (micropip install of ioc-finder at run time); the bench n8n image has no Python runner, so the n8n side stops there with an error after Mark as read, and nothing past it runs on the n8n side. Wait 1 Minute (60 s) needs a time-compression overlay. The Slack text references a node named urlscan.io that does not exist in the template
